facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Every morning Sara woke up in the cold attic before anyone else was awake. She had a long and hard day of work ahead and very little breakfast waiting for her. She could have decided to be distant and cold toward the people she would meet that day. Nobody would have been surprised and nobody would have blamed her for it at all. But Sara made a different and more deliberate decision every single morning before she rose. She decided to be kind — not because she felt like it but because she had chosen it. She had learned that kindness waits for no one and arrives when we invite it deliberately. Kindness is a choice.
